retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Intake must reconstruct candidate truth with source refs, confidence, and ambiguity markers for each material claim.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::candidate-truth-reconstruction::intake must reconstruct candidate truth with source refs, confidence, and ambiguity markers for each material claim.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: The intake model must support a bounded pilot on an existing skill project such as `/Users/apple/Developer/Personal/products/justin-mc-lai-skills`, preferably by one skill pack before whole-repo adoption.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::existing-project-pilot::the intake model must support a bounded pilot on an existing skill project such as `/users/apple/developer/personal/products/justin-mc-lai-skills`, preferably by one skill pack before whole-repo adoption.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Ambiguous, stale, conflicting, low-confidence, or unproven behavior must fail closed into questions, exclusions, or change routing instead of freezing as authoritative truth.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::fail-closed-ambiguity::ambiguous, stale, conflicting, low-confidence, or unproven behavior must fail closed into questions, exclusions, or change routing instead of freezing as authoritative truth.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: `beacon implement` may complete as no-op/evidence-only execution when frozen ACs are already satisfied by existing code and every task has evidence-backed closure.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::implement-no-op-admission::`beacon implement` may complete as no-op/evidence-only execution when frozen acs are already satisfied by existing code and every task has evidence-backed closure.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: The frozen truth source must be resolver-selected `features/<slug>/{truth,tests,tasks,evidence}.md`; generated JSON, legacy triptych, provider graphs, and support research cannot win authority.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::package-authority::the frozen truth source must be resolver-selected `features/<slug>/{truth,tests,tasks,evidence}.md`; generated json, legacy triptych, provider graphs, and support research cannot win authority.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Third-party or local code-map providers such as `qi-dev-understand-anything` must be treated as evidence providers only, never as requirement authority.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::provider-evidence-boundary::third-party or local code-map providers such as `qi-dev-understand-anything` must be treated as evidence providers only, never as requirement authority.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: `beacon QA` must validate truth-map resolution, package coverage, evidence refs, provider boundary, governance/doctor verification, and current behavior satisfaction.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::qa-truth-governance-verification::`beacon qa` must validate truth-map resolution, package coverage, evidence refs, provider boundary, governance/doctor verification, and current behavior satisfaction.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Code2truth intake must build a source inventory from existing code, docs, skills, tests, CLI behavior, Beacon lighthouse/source-architecture outputs, and available provider artifacts.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::source-inventory::code2truth intake must build a source inventory from existing code, docs, skills, tests, cli behavior, beacon lighthouse/source-architecture outputs, and available provider artifacts.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: `tasks.md` must express implementation intent and may mark existing-code satisfaction through evidence refs; it must not fake source churn or replace execution/gate evidence.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::tasks-evidence-closure::`tasks.md` must express implementation intent and may mark existing-code satisfaction through evidence refs; it must not fake source churn or replace execution/gate evidence.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Candidate truth can become formal truth only after user confirmation and governed promotion into the Beacon feature package.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::user-confirmation-gate::candidate truth can become formal truth only after user confirmation and governed promotion into the beacon feature package.::

reviewer.purpose: Review implementation/spec drift and architecture-boundary drift.

tester.purpose: Check implementation evidence and verification readiness before acceptance.
